name: Uniform Child Custody Jurisdiction and Enforcement Act

body: A child custody proceeding that pertains to an Indian child as defined in section 46b-116a is not subject to this chapter to the extent that it is governed by sections 46b-116 to 46b-116aa, inclusive.
history: History: P.A. 99-185 effective July 1, 2000; P.A. 23-113 replaced references to federal Indian Child Welfare Act with references to Connecticut Indian Child Welfare Act, Secs. 46b-116 to 46b-116aa, effective June 26, 2023.
content.plainText: A child custody proceeding that pertains to an Indian child as defined in section 46b-116a is not subject to this chapter to the extent that it is governed by sections 46b-116 to 46b-116aa, inclusive.
